Developers weighing the two tools, or wondering what agent-style coding feels like day to day, are the audience.

item.title: [infoq] Agent 编程能力从 10% 飙到 70%，Anthropic 新模型却遭遇灵魂拷问：我什么时候才会用它？
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5 on September 28, the second model in the Claude 5.5 family, claiming over 30% faster output and up to 30% lower cost per task. It jumped from 10.3% to 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, beating Opus 5.5's published best, while early testers report roughly a third fewer tool calls and about half the shell executions. Base44 measured an average of 3.6 iterations per app build against 7.7 for Opus 5, which matters to teams running coding agents such as Claude Code.

item.title: [v2ex] [Claude] 现在凌晨 4 点突然睡不着，梦见自己 cluade 弹出来了确认提示框
item.description: A V2EX user who couldn't sleep at 4am describes a dream in which Claude popped up a confirmation dialog they couldn't click "yes" on, while fretting that 80% of their remaining quota would reset in five minutes. It's a self-deprecating look at how closely heavy users of AI coding tools track quotas and reset windows.

item.title: [infoq] Agent 不只烧 Token：为什么 Agent Sandbox 正在变得重要？
item.description: At its Yunqi Conference, Alibaba Cloud launched Agent Sandbox, described by Wu Jiesheng of its elastic computing team as a "new compute form for intelligence": each sandbox runs as a Kubernetes Pod inside a MicroVM, with identity, network and data controls. A roundtable featuring Alibaba Cloud, AMD, Kingsoft Office and 51job explains why production Agent workloads need this layer on top of Docker and Kubernetes.

item.title: [infoq] 上下文优势：AI 增长战略缺失的关键拼图 ｜ 技术趋势
item.description: An InfoQ trend piece introduces the idea of a “context advantage”: in its example, an AI correctly predicts high conversion for a fictional customer, Maya, but still sends a discount that policy forbids because it can't see her unresolved service case or the brand's pricing rules. The argument is that capable models are now widely available, so the real moat is a company's accumulated business judgment, built outward from an existing customer 360.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 一个 AI 工具站 vocalove.io
item.description: A V2EX user shares vocalove.io, a self-built AI tool site that wraps several mainstream models in one place: video and image-to-video, text-to-image and image-to-image generation, multi-voice TTS, and voice cloning. There's a free quota for testing, handy for developers who want to try these multimodal features without integrating each API themselves.

item.description: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

The post asks whether this is a psychological problem or simply a side effect of long working hours, and will resonate with anyone who stays permanently online for work.

item.title: [infoq] Bun 在四个月内将 53.5 万行 Zig 代码重写为 Rust，消除了大量内存泄漏
item.description: Bun creator Jarred Sumner has rewritten the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime and package manager from 535,496 lines of Zig into Rust in four months, far faster than the year a small team would normally need. The port, orchestrated through roughly 50 dynamic workflows using a pre-release Claude model, removes recurring use-after-free, double-free and leak bugs via Rust's borrow checker and was validated against a test suite with over a million assertions.

item.title: [infoq] MariaDB 13 扩展 Oracle 兼容性，改善开发者体验与可观测性
item.description: MariaDB Community Server 13.0 has reached GA under the project's rolling-release model rather than an LTS line. It natively supports Oracle PL/SQL-style REF CURSOR and RECORD types usable as routine parameters and function return types, and UPDATE statements gain a RETURNING clause with OLD_VALUE() to fetch pre- and post-update values in one round trip. item.title: [infoq] Uber 使用子集群重新设计 M3DB 分片策略，降低故障影响
item.description: Uber redesigned shard placement in M3DB, its distributed time-series database, by grouping nodes into fixed-size subclusters that own non-overlapping shard ranges while replicas stay spread across isolation groups. In the old model a single node failure could touch as many as (n-1)/n of the cluster; the new design confines failures, maintenance and scaling to one subcluster, at the cost of requiring equal instance weights and bulk, subcluster-sized expansion.

It ships as a desktop app, a Docker image and a CLI, with a built-in AI assistant and an MCP Server, which makes it relevant to developers who want one lightweight tool across many database engines.

It weighs when the AI equivalents of Douyin, WeChat and Xiaohongshu will show up, and whether the boom is repeating the dot-com bubble of 2000.

item.title: [github_trending] VectifyAI/PageIndex
item.description: PageIndex, from VectifyAI, is a RAG approach that skips the vector database and chunking in favor of reasoning-based, context-aware retrieval, billed as reading “like a human.” An SDK is available via pip install -U pageindex, plus cloud and docs; it targets developers who want retrieval without embedding and chunking pipelines.

Unlike frameworks like GSD, BMAD, or Spec-Kit that own the whole process, these skills are deliberately small, adaptable, composable, and model-agnostic, giving developers more control. The hardware is released under CERN-OHL-P and the software under MIT, and the project is still at Alpha with features marked work in progress. It targets hardware builders who want to assemble a radar and learn phased-array and FMCW signal processing hands-on.
